cases.script:
# GS-005: An acid trap captures ammonia as ammonium
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
seal v1 500mL
add v1 NH3 0.001mol
inspect v1
new
add v2 water 100mL
add v2 HCl 0.002mol
seal v2 500mL
add v2 NH3 0.001mol
inspect v2
cases.original_forecast: Protonation stores ammonia as ammonium and reduces the uncharged ammonia fraction available to the headspace.

original_criteria.criterion: The acid trap has a larger ammonium fraction and a smaller gas-phase NH3 fraction.
All added nitrogen is accounted for in each vessel; the acidified solution need not become neutral.

changed_source_expectations.qualification: Original qualitative criteria plus prospective robust trapping/conservation prerequisites; no rate or empirical calibration claim.
